resources.string: Smart charging
Charge in the cheapest hours before you leave

When the car is plugged in at home, the bridge moves tonight\'s charging to the cheapest hours before you need the car, using the car\'s own charge timer (2014–2017 cars). The car always charges until full, and your own timer is put back afterwards. New: keep an eye on the first nights.
